text:
Sofia (Community): Quick heads-up: we've published tooling-kit v1.1.0 and are running a short Community Tooling Kickoff next Wed 4pm PT. RSVP + demo signups: https://events.redwood.ai/tooling-kickoff — demo slots limited. Please share with maintainers. :sparkles:

Aiden (Engineering): Congrats! is v1.1.0 backwards compatible? any notable fixes?

Sofia (Community): Non-breaking. High-level bullets below (copy/paste for changelog):

```
tooling-kit v1.1.0
- new: local CLI "rw-tool" subcommands for template scaffolding
- new: telemetry opt-in flag for dev builds (--telemetry=false)
- perf: faster cold-start for CLI by lazy-loading heavy deps
- fix: Windows path handling in the sample generator
- docs: quickstart for creating and publishing community templates
```

Ravi (Maintainer): Can you paste an install snippet and a quick example of the new CLI usage? I'll add to the repo README.

Sofia (Community): Sure — copyable snippets below:

```bash
# install
npm install -g @redwood/tooling-kit@1.1.0

# scaffold a template
rw-tool scaffold template my-awesome-template --author="ACME"

# run template validator
rw-tool validate ./my-awesome-template
```

Nora (Docs): I'll add the quickstart and a migration note. Ravi, want me to open the PR for the docs update?

Ravi (Maintainer): Please — that'd be great. Also adding a short note about the telemetry opt-out for maintainers who run CI.

Ken (DevRel): For the Kickoff I'm reserving 5 demo slots (8min + 4min Q&A). Maintainers can demo templates or the CLI workflows. I'll also prepare a one-paragraph announcement and a short social copy. Can maintainers attach a gif or screenshot?

Ravi (Maintainer): I can record a 20s gif showing scaffold -> validate -> publish flow. I'll include a short perf note (CLI cold-start ~280ms after lazy-load).

Sofia (Community): Awesome — RSVP link includes demo signup. We also have an office hour Tue 11am PT to help with publishing and validator issues.

release-bot: Automated release: tooling-kit v1.1.0 published by @sofia. Changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tooling-kit/compare/v1.0.2...v1.1.0. CI: all checks passed. :robot_face:

Aiden (Engineering): Quick note: if demos touch Dedicated or Private flows, include a tiny config snippet and p95 numbers. Ops can supply a sample dashboard screenshot on request.

Ken (DevRel): Copy. I'll add a demo template to the event doc with fields: "what it demos / deployment type / p95 / screenshot link".

Sofia (Community): Thanks everyone! If maintainers want a short blurb for the repo or social copy, drop here or DM me. Looking forward to the kickoff :)
